item.title: Humans Have Rights. Machines Do Not.
item.description: <p><em>This essay originally appeared in <a href="https://www.techpolicy.press/humans-have-rights-machines-do-not/">Tech Policy Press</a>.</em></p> <p>Last year, Character.AI <a href="https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.flmd.433581/gov.uscourts.flmd.433581.59.0.pdf">asked</a> a federal court in Florida to dismiss a wrongful-death suit, brought by the mother of a fourteen-year-old boy who had killed himself after months of conversation with its chatbot. The company made two arguments. One, that the chatbot&#8217;s words were speech that its users had a First Amendment right to receive. And two, that Character.AI was a service rather than a product&#8212;so product-liability law could not touch it. A critical flaw in VMware vCenter lets an attacker with network access bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system, Broadcom, which owns VMware, said in an advisory published today.
Fixed versions are out for all supported branches, and the company lists no workaround. vCenter is the central console for managing an organization's ESX hosts and virtual machines.

item.title: Drupal Patches Critical Installer Flaw That Could Give Unauthenticated Attackers Control of Sites
item.description:

item.title: Everything Is a Web Application, Including Your Firewall
item.description: One of the early targets of PHP2Shell exploitation was the firewall. On October 28, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were exploiting the two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Both flaws let anyone execute code on the web server without authentication. The disclosure itself went a little wrong.

item.title: PHP Warns of Critical Security Flaws Affecting All Supported Versions, Fixes Coming November 19
item.description:
The maintainers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday issued an advisory announcing an upcoming security release that addresses critical flaws.
The release is scheduled for November 19, 2026, between 2 and 2:30 p.m. UTC.
"These releases are part of PHP's regular four-week release cycle and will address security vulnerabilities affecting all supported PHP versions," the maintainers said.

item.description:
